senses.gloss:
परूष(क)
(1) GREWIA ASIATICA LINN. (Avk; Bpn, p. 570; Chopra; Dgv, nr.
56; Dutt; DWH 1, p. 238; Gul; HB; HK; Kav; KB 1, p. 388-389;
MW; Na 1, nr. 75; Nadk. 1, nr. 1158; PW; Vśs) = G. ELASTICA ROYLE
(Nadk. 1, nr. 1158) = G. VESTITA WALL. (Nadk. 1, nr. 1158: G. ELAS-
TICA VAR. G. VESTITA) (see Hooker 1, p. 386-387 about G. ASIATICA
LINN. VAR. VESTITA WALL) [= G. ABUTILISSIMA VENT.] (HK); HK
probably made an error; the Index Kewensis indicates: G. ASIATICA
WALL. पर्तिम् = G. ABUTILIFOLIA VENT. EX JUSS.; see Hooker 1,
p. 390;
(2) CARAPA MOLUCCENSIS LAM. = XYLOCARPUS GRANATUM KOEN.
(MW; PW; Vśs).
